period_basis: Two consecutive 12-month periods from incorporation; agent cash timing follows actual service start
assumptions: One China-resident natural-person owner; US single-member LLC with default disregarded classification
Northwest formation sample: 39 plus 100 state fee; first-year registered agent included; renewal 125
Minimum Wyoming annual report paid online: 60 plus 2.4 percent = 61.44; one report included in each period
One current-year Form 5472 plus pro forma Form 1120 service sample: 599 each filing cycle; scope must be accepted in writing
No invoice is a guaranteed total; unknown address, checkout, transmission, operating, professional and tax costs remain variables

additional_cost_variables.F: Fax, return fax or mailing not included in chosen service
additional_cost_variables.A: Qualifying legal-address and mail services if needed; not assumed zero
additional_cost_variables.D: Website/domain/email/phone additions or renewals if needed
additional_cost_variables.B: Bookkeeping, extra returns and professional services outside standard scope
additional_cost_variables.T: Actual US, state/local and China taxes as applicable; not assumed zero
additional_cost_variables.U: Transaction, non-base banking and operating costs
additional_cost_variables.V: Closure or exceptional remediation costs if incurred
